title: Link, Embed, Import, or LTI: Four Ways Into an LMS
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: The same resource moving four ways toward the same generic learning management system: a link, an embed, a Common Cartridge import, and an LTI tool.

educational.topic: Four ways to bring an OER into a learning management system
learningObjectives: The learner will choose the right way to bring a resource into an LMS for each of four teacher needs.
prerequisites: LMS import, Common Cartridge, and LTI from [Chapter 10](../../chapters/10-portability-reuse/index.md).

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore a reference picture, then quiz on the same picture
keyQuestions: Where does the resource live afterward?
Does anything need to come back to the gradebook?
commonMisconceptions: A link that fails is an embedding problem
LTI and a link do the same thing
assessmentOpportunities: You want an external quiz tool to send each student's score to the gradebook. Which method?
You want a simulation to appear on your course page. Which method?
You want colleagues with a different LMS to receive the same unit. Which method?

controls.name: Explore and Quiz buttons
controls.description: switch between exploring the poster and answering quiz questions.

controls.name: Poster zones
controls.description: hover or press to read about that part of the poster. In quiz mode a press is your answer.

controls.name: Try Again
controls.description: repeats the quiz after the last question.
